concept: Cross-chain comparison of EVM and Solana lending design

claims.text: Morpho Blue is the EVM baseline for where state lives. One singleton contract keeps every position in a storage mapping, `mapping(Id => mapping(address => Position)) public position`, and its README calls the protocol a 'simple, immutable, and governance-minimized base layer'. (high confidence)

Jupiter Lend is the Solana deployment of Fluid's Unified Liquidity Layer, which first shipped on Ethereum. It opened publicly in August 2025 as a partnership between Jupiter and Fluid (the former Instadapp team), and DefiLlama still lists a separate Fluid lending protocol on Ethereum. (medium confidence)

Shared liquidity under isolated front-ends is now a pattern on both chains. Aave V4 uses a Hub and Spoke model in which a Liquidity Hub consolidates liquidity and accounting and Spokes implement modular borrowing with isolated risk. Jupiter Lend's README describes a Liquidity layer shared by Lending and Vaults, each keeping its own risk parameters 'within set limits'. This pairing is analysis, not a claim made by either project. (medium confidence)

Jupiter Lend liquidates by ticks. Positions with similar debt-to-collateral ratios share a tick, and when a tick crosses a vault's Liquidation Threshold all its positions are processed in one transaction. Each liquidation sells only enough collateral to bring the ratio back to the Liquidation Threshold, with a penalty on the liquidated part only that varies by vault. A position beyond the Liquidation Max Limit leaves the tick system and is fully liquidated. (high confidence)

Jupiter Lend on Solana is built from three programs. Liquidity custodies every token and tracks supply and borrow positions. Lending (Earn, jlTokens) and Vaults (Borrow) hold no tokens and reach Liquidity by cross-program invocation. Each borrow vault has one supply token and one borrow token, and vault positions are represented as NFTs. (high confidence)

Aave V3 E-mode and Kamino elevation groups both restrict borrowing to a related asset set, but they differ in shape. In Aave a user picks one E-mode category, borrowing is then limited to assets in that category, and an asset can belong to several categories. In Kamino a user requests a group, each group names one permitted `debt_reserve`, a market holds up to 32 groups, a reserve can join up to 20, and leaving the group or borrowing outside it restores the per-reserve parameters. (high confidence)
